title: Optimal robust comonotonic risk sharing under operational constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.09452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Risk-sharing arrangements such as reinsurance programs and catastrophe pools must satisfy operational constraints, including capacity limits, attachment bands, retention rules and cession limits. Under distortion risk measures, the unconstrained optimum assigns each loss layer to the participant for whom that layer is least costly, but operational constraints break this layerwise rule, and there is no general method to compute the constrained optimum. We show that, for comonotonic allocations, the participants' distortion risk measures and the operational constraints are linear in the amount of each loss layer held by each participant, so the constrained risk-sharing problem on a discretized loss is a linear program that standard software can solve. translated_title: 运营约束下的最优鲁棒同单调风险分担
translated_abstract: 诸如再保险计划和巨灾池等风险分担安排必须满足运营约束，包括承保能力上限、起赔带、自留规则和分保限额。在失真风险度量下，无约束的最优解是将每一损失层分配给对该层成本最低的参与者，但运营约束打破了这种逐层分配规则，且目前尚无一般方法来计算约束条件下的最优解。我们证明，对于同单调分配，参与者的失真风险度量和运营约束在每个参与者所持有的各损失层数量上都是线性的，因此离散化损失上的约束风险分担问题可以表述为一个线性规划问题，标准软件即可求解。其对偶问题给出了各损失层的支持价格，以及放松每条运营约束的边际价值。在起约束作用的约束集合发生变化的情形下，约束最优值……
tldr: 该论文证明，在失真风险度量下，带运营约束的同单调最优风险分担问题可转化为线性规划进行求解，其对偶问题还能提供损失层的支持价格以及放松各约束条件的边际价值。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that optimal comonotonic risk sharing under distortion risk measures with operational constraints can be reformulated as a linear program, whose dual provides supporting prices for loss layers and the marginal value of relaxing each constraint.
